set protocols pim interface all.explanation: This command enables Protocol Independent Multicast (PIM) on a specified network interface (`[parameter1]`) for multicast routing in Junos OS.

mode sparse.explanation: Configure the mode of PIM protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols pim ssm default.explanation: 配置PIM SSM（源特定组播）为默认模式。

parameters.name: mode
parameters.explanation: Interface mode, passive means passive mode.

parameters.name: mode
